subject: Post-call: Security & retention checklist + next steps for pilot
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@octavebank.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@octavebank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Security & retention checklist + next steps for pilot

Hi Samir / Lydia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and concrete next steps so we’re aligned before the pilot kickoff: 

Key pain points you shared
- Need clear audit log retention options for user-level events (30/90/365 days) with exportable traces for audits.
- SOC 2 evidence required for in-scope controls (logging, access reviews, key management).
- DPA-specific language and a plain-language summary for procurement.
- Pen test window & artifact requirements needed before production cutover.

Goals we agreed
- Run 30-day pilot on Redwood Dedicated in us-west with audit log retention set to 90 days and daily exports.
- Provide a SOC 2 evidence matrix and sample artifacts to satisfy your InfoSec team.
- Deliver a DPA draft for your legal review and a short mutual action plan to track owners/dates.

Actions / owners
1) I will share a concise evidence matrix and a DPA draft by EOD Friday (attaching CSV + PDF). (Avery)
2) Irene to outline what artifacts we can provide from our hosted logs and the expected format (JSON/CSV). (Irene)
3) Lydia / Samir to confirm whether a 30- or 90-day pen-test window is preferred and any third-party scanner requirements. (Octave)
4) Monica will schedule a short technical runbook call next week with your infra team to walk through export mechanics and retention settings. (Monica)

Attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-matrix.csv (matrix of control -> artifact examples), redwood-dpa-draft.pdf (plain-language DPA draft), octave-mup-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan template)

If that aligns, please reply with any corrections and confirm who from your side should be on the runbook call.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@octavebank.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@octavebank.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & retention checklist + next steps for pilot

Thanks Avery — appreciate the structured recap. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Pen test window: leaning toward 90 days post-implementation for scheduling reasons. We run third-party scans via VeritySec and need the server-side endpoints + audit log exports in place.
2) Evidence: Can the SOC 2 matrix differentiate between hosted (managed) evidence vs. artifact we need to produce? Our auditors prefer clear ownership columns.
3) DPA: we’ll share redlines back; Lydia will own that.

Also attaching our internal evidence intake template so you can map fields directly.

Samir Patel
Head of InfoSec, Octave Bank
samir@octavebank.com
Attachment: octave-evidence-intake-template.xlsx

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & retention checklist + next steps for pilot

Samir —

Thanks — good notes. A few follow-ups and confirmations: 

- Pen test: 90 days window is fine; we’ll coordinate dates once the pilot environment is stable. We support standard scanners and can provide ephemeral credentials for VeritySec on the dedicated pool.

- SOC 2 matrix: attached CSV includes an "ownership" column (Redwood vs. Octave) and an "artifact example" column. I highlighted items we can deliver immediately (logging exports, access review records, KMS rotation docs).

- Evidence mapping: Monica will run a 45-minute technical walkthrough with your infra team on Tuesday 5/18 at 11am PT (invite to follow). Please let us know who should join.

Irene — can you confirm the export formats and an estimated turnaround time for producing sample artifacts (logs, access lists, rotation history)? If possible, call out anything that would require an NDA or additional approvals.

Thanks —
Avery

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@octavebank.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@octavebank.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & retention checklist + next steps for pilot

Hi Samir / Lydia —

Follow-up from my side with the evidence/format checklist you asked for. High level: we can produce the following artifacts within the pilot timeframe without an NDA escalation. Anything marked with * requires an executed DPA or customer-approved access request.

Artifacts we can supply (examples and format)
- Audit log exports: event-level JSON (schema included), CSV summary for faster review. (Available immediately for pilot with 90-day retention)
- Access reviews: CSV of IAM role assignments + timestamped admin actions (90-day snapshot)
- KMS rotation history: CSV export of rotation timestamps and key IDs*
- Pen test support bundle: network endpoints, ephemeral access accounts, and a canned log export for the test window (requires scheduled window + authorization)
- SOC 2 control mapping: narrative plus sample artifacts (PDF/CSV) for CC A-C relevant controls

Estimated turnaround for sample package: 3 business days after you sign the MUP and confirm the test window. If you prefer, we can stage the package in a shared Drive folder for direct download.

Small ask: please share your evidence intake template (Samir attached one — thanks). Monica will map fields during the runbook call so we can pre-populate the MUP.

Irene Choi
Head of Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0124

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-evidence-matrix.csv, redwood-dpa-draft.pdf
